|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days. | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days. |

| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty. | 1-year limited warranty. |
| **Specs / In the box** | Same - 40hr battery, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, carry case, etc. | Same - 40hr battery, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, carry case, etc. |
| **Seller rating** | **4.8 out of 5 (1,900 reviews)** | **4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)** |
